questions: How many students in a class?
Class mein kitne students hote hain?
faqs.answer: Batches are capped at 15 students (sample answer for this demo) so every student gets attention.
Each subject is taught by a teacher with several years of experience at that level. You can meet the teacher at the free demo class.
There is a short test every week and a progress report to parents every month.

questions: Can my child attend from home?
faqs.answer: Classes are held in person. Ask the team on WhatsApp if you need an online option for a particular course.

questions: Are there separate batches for girls?
faqs.answer: Yes, separate boys and girls batches are available for most courses. Tell us your preference when you enquire.

questions: How do I pay the fee?
faqs.answer: Fees are paid monthly in advance by cash, bank transfer or mobile wallet. Ask the team about instalments for long courses.
